decision_conditions:
DRAWING AND DOCUMENT NUMBERS:  The development hereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:

 202_0000 (Site Location Plan); 202_1000 (Site Plan); 202_1001 Rev C (Proposed Plans); 202_1002 (Proposed Plans); 202_1200 Rev C (Proposed Front & Rear Elevations); 202_1100 Rev D (Proposed Sections AA, BB, CC); SBM-P24-01 (Item 1; Cortizo – Top Hung Open Out Window); SBM-P24-02 (Item 2: Cortizo – Top Hung Opening Out Window and Fixed Screen); Fujitsu Air Conditioning Specifications document; Design and Access Statement Rev B (including Sustainable Design and Construction Statement) 

REASON: To comply with Section 70(1)(a) of the Town and Country Act 1990 as amended and the Reason for Grant and also for the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
description:
S73 application (Minor Material Amendment) to vary the wording of condition 2 (DRAWINGS AND DOCUMENT NUMBERS ) of planning permission ref: P2025/1084/FUL   dated 10 July 2025 for the: 'Erection of a ground floor side extension with roof lights above, and first floor rear/side extensions, and external alterations including new entrance door location and new windows to front, side, and rear façades, replacement of corner render panel on front façade with brick and installation of 3 air conditioning units to ground floor roof extension.'  The application seeks the following amendments:
a)    introduction of new rear obscurely glazed window at first floor level (part retrospectively)
